signal.ratchet: sense (identity/pulse) → elicit (accept|decline|cancel) → actuate (invoke/oneshot) → confer apex. Elicitation is the absorption waist, not a generation event and not consumption.
signal.dark_law: Seat 2 executor-emitter stays DARK until live rows have non-null quality/cost/reward. A green structural check over a dark emitter is the silent-degradation trap.

OAuth is already live (source:public, VERIFIED_RESOURCE_BOUND). Rank-1 remaining is AS registration (CIMD false), not stuffing oauth{} CIMD into the plugin.
